reason: An evidence-first research plugin that collects and ranks frontier AI signals, builds versioned provenance bundles, and gates reproduction claims using recorded attempts and verifier evidence.

summaries.zh: 一个面向前沿人工智能研究的插件，用于收集和整理信号、构建带来源的证据包，并依据复现实验记录评估研究结论。
summaries.en: An evidence-first frontier AI research plugin for collecting signals, building provenance-rich evidence bundles, and assessing reproduction claims from recorded attempts.

capabilities: Fetches curated research and release signals from public sources and optional X, GitHub, and Hugging Face APIs
Persists a local corpus containing source provenance, versioned evidence bundles, watch state, and source health
Assesses and records reproduction claims, attempts, metrics, artifacts, resources, failures, and verifier outcomes
Exports a local-first Trackio logbook scaffold and reproduction handoff manifest
Uses optional GitHub and X credentials for API access
